rules.availability: anything but CAUSAL_ACTIVE is UNAVAILABLE; no timestamp semantics are invented here
rules.binding: CAUSAL_ACTIVE requires a BOUND producer (see PRODUCER_BINDING_MANIFEST.v1.json); a static causal candidate without one is STATIC_CAUSAL_CANDIDATE_UNBOUND
rules.callables: user callables passed to apply/map/transform/pipe/agg/rolling().apply are followed; an unfollowable one is UNRESOLVED
rules.dynamic: a bound, executable producer must also pass the prefix-invariance probe; the probe never replaces the static proof
rules.forward: negative shift/diff, any np.roll, bfill, interpolate, centred windows and full-sample reductions make a path NON_CAUSAL
rules.lookback: lookback_bars = bars of history a value depends on, current bar included (max offset + 1); UNBOUNDED for ewm, expanding, cumulative ops, ffill and pandas' default-padding pct_change
rules.reaching: statements run in order; branches join the definitions that may reach a use; disagreement in class or lookback is UNRESOLVED
rules.scope: nested function, lambda and class bodies are never executed as the outer body
rules.unknown: unknown calls, dynamic dispatch, cycles, depth and budget exhaustion are UNRESOLVED
